stem.en: The book's chart of the Harappan civilisation names three stages. Which list puts them in order, oldest first?

text.en: Mature Harappan, Early Harappan, Late Harappan

feedback.en: The Mature stage is the stage of the big cities, and those came after the Early stage, not before it.

text.en: Early Harappan, Mature Harappan, Late Harappan
Early Harappan, Late Harappan, Mature Harappan

feedback.en: Late Harappan comes after the cities. It runs from 1900 to 1300 BCE, and the Mature stage ended at 1900 BCE.

text.en: Late Harappan, Mature Harappan, Early Harappan

feedback.en: This is the order backwards. In BCE years a bigger number is older, so 3300 BCE comes before 1300 BCE.

explanation.en: Early Harappan is 3300 to 2600 BCE, Mature Harappan is 2600 to 1900 BCE, and Late Harappan is 1900 to 1300 BCE.

hints.en: In BCE years, a bigger number means longer ago.
